title: Decisions
summary: Make programs choose what to do, using comparisons, if statements and logic.
outcomes: Compare values and get True or False
Choose between actions with if, elif and else
Combine conditions with and, or and not
Write programs that respond differently to what the user types
Avoid the usual mistakes: = instead of ==, wrong indentation, a missing colon

lessons.title: True or False
lessons.summary: Compare values with ==, !=, <, > and friends, and meet the booleans.

lessons.title: if, elif and else
lessons.summary: Run different code depending on a condition, and learn how indentation groups lines.

lessons.title: and, or, not
lessons.summary: Combine conditions, and learn what Python treats as true or false.

lessons.title: Programs that decide
lessons.summary: Put it all together in small programs: grades, leap years, login checks and text adventures.

gameSummary: Your rover must cope with whatever it finds. Use if and sensors so one program works on every map.
